Author: CoelZzz
Name: Raid Helper
Description:
Shows a compact helper window with live mechanic calls for supported fights.

Dancing Mad (Ultimate): P1 rings, gazes, rocks and cleaves; P2 Forsaken and Trine; P3 Black Hole and hand attacks; P4 debuffs; P5 Chaotic Flood.

The Epic of Alexander (Ultimate): P2 nisi lineup; P3 Wormhole; P4 Fate Calibration Alpha and Beta.
Punchline: Mechanic calls for high-end raids, one fight at a time.
Changelog: DMU: P3 opening calls (fast fire/water, wind orb start, Latitudinal/Longitudinal Implosion order, look at/away from Exdeath), P4 Mana Release call using the charged Thunder/Blizzard real/fake, P4 Flood colour now accounts for Exdeath's fake lasers, P2 Past/Future's End call stays up until the cleaves lock in, P3 live Black Hole calls in boxes. TEA: Almighty Judgment 3-to-1 move call (middle / 1 / 3 / 4).
